name: custom/backorder
description: Shopware 6 Backorder Plugin — allows ordering out-of-stock or low-stock products with per-order tracking, limits, and oldest-first allocation.

description.en-GB: Enables configurable product-level backorders, mixed-stock splitting, backorder limits, and stock replenishment allocation.
description.de-DE: Ermöglicht konfigurierbare Nachbestellungen auf Produktebene, Teillieferungen, Limits und Bestandszuteilung.
